name: Medical and Nursing Explorers Clubs
what_you_do: Join a student run club that meets each month at a HonorHealth medical center. You explore health care careers (medical or nursing).
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 during the school year, at least 13 at the start of the school year.
deadline_text: 2026-27 application is closed. 2027-28 application opens mid-May 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it opens in mid-May 2027. The page does not give steps. Contact studentvolunteers@honorhealth.com.
notes: Medical Explorers meet at Thompson Peak, Deer Valley and John C. Lincoln Medical Centers. The Nursing Explorers meet near Deer Valley Medical Center.
